description: This file defines React functional components wrapping Radix UI's Collapsible primitives, providing a customizable collapsible UI component with associated Trigger and Content components.

methods.name: Collapsible
methods.description: A React component that renders a Radix Collapsible Root with passed props, facilitating expandable/collapsible sections.

methods.name: CollapsibleTrigger
methods.description: A React component that renders a Radix Collapsible Trigger, used to toggle the collapse/expand state.

methods.name: CollapsibleContent
methods.description: A React component that renders the content area of the collapsible, which shows or hides based on trigger interaction.
